translatorChecks.reviewerNotes: Preserved every repeated address/name exchange, all hesitations and truncations, the multi-paragraph bracketed turns, and source uncertainty braces. The odd source phrase {שילמד} is rendered literally as {he should learn} rather than normalized.

qa.reviewNotes: Corrected '[Who, who know them]' to '[That they, who know them].' The source's malformed/uncertain שהם שמכירים אותם contains an explicit 'they' plus a following relative particle; converting both into a repeated 'who' omitted that pronoun and invented a repetition. The deliberately awkward correction preserves the source oddity without silently resolving it. All 68 paragraphs, turns, truncations, braces, and other repetitions remain intact.
